clusters.note: “Earliest found” is the earliest copy THIS search discovered — not proof of the original.

search_links.name: Google Lens

search_links.name: TinEye

legend.Verified: Geometric match: hundreds of image features line up under one transform.
legend.Lead: Looks similar (hash / embedding) but not verified. Treat as a possibility only.
legend.Inferred: Direction suggested by clear differences (e.g. one is a crop of the other). Not proof of who made which.
legend.Captured: We downloaded the media from that page and stored its hash.

coverage: This map shows only what the search could see on the public web as a logged-out visitor. It cannot see private chats, closed groups, deleted posts or logged-in content, so absence from the map does not mean absence online.
